traceability.notes:
The story 024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS requires centralized filtering of backtick-wrapped annotation keywords during comment normalization, preservation of word/character boundaries, correct handling of mixed inline-code and real annotations, multi-line applicability, no regressions, and documentation of the behavior.
Implementation in src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-format-internal.ts modifies normalizeCommentLine to remove all backtick-wrapped spans via a regex (/`[^`]*`/g) and replace them with spaces of equal length, then locate the first @story/@req/@supports tag (if any) and return the substring starting at that tag, or a star-stripped line otherwise. This matches REQ-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE, REQ-PRESERVE-BOUNDARIES, and REQ-CENTRALIZED-FILTER, and is documented in the function’s JSDoc and @supports annotation, satisfying the documentation acceptance criterion.
The dedicated tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format-internal.test.ts directly verify that: (1) backtick-wrapped @story/@req are removed and no annotations are detected when no real tags exist; (2) documentation-style patterns like "`@story` + `@req`" are filtered while preserving spacing; (3) a real @story outside backticks is still detected and surfaced as the normalized output; (4) multiple backtick segments in one line are handled; and (5) lines without backticks remain unchanged aside from usual normalization. These exercise the core functionality, common patterns, and mixed real+inline-code scenarios described in the acceptance criteria.
normalizeCommentLine is a per-line helper used by the main valid-annotation-format rule, which already has tests for multi-line comments. With the shared helper now performing inline-code filtering and the full Jest suite (including multi-line tests) passing, the "Multi-Line Support" and "No Regression" criteria are effectively satisfied.
Given the aligned implementation, passing targeted tests, and a clean full test run, all acceptance criteria and requirements for this story are met. Therefore the status is PASSED.
